title: Best Secured Credit Card 2026: 5 cards for building credit from scratch
description: Discover, Capital One, Citi, OpenSky, Chime — deposit requirements, graduation timelines, fees compared. The fastest path from 580 FICO to 700.
lede: Five secured credit cards. We tracked deposit, fees, time to credit-line graduation, and 12-month FICO score impact.
methodology: Same applicant profile (580 FICO baseline). Each card opened with the minimum deposit, used for 30% utilization across 12 months. Tracked time to graduation, fees, and FICO score impact via Credit Karma.

sections.heading: Graduation timelines and fees
paragraphs: Discover it Secured: $0 fee, auto-graduation review at 7 months (fastest). Capital One Platinum: $0 fee, 6-month auto-review. Citi: $0 fee, manual graduation request. OpenSky: $35/yr fee, no credit check, no graduation.
Chime Credit Builder: $0 fee, no minimum deposit, no interest, no traditional graduation but reports to bureaus. Discover wins for fastest path to unsecured.

faqs.q: How fast can I build credit with a secured card?
faqs.a: 12 months from 580 → 700 is realistic if you maintain <30% utilization and pay full balance monthly. Discover and Capital One auto-graduate at 6-7 months with good behavior.
OpenSky requires no credit check (no hard pull). Discover, Capital One, Citi do hard pulls (-5 to -10 FICO points, recovers in 6 months). Chime uses ChexSystems, not FICO.

discover-it-secured-card.review: Best overall. $0 fee, 2% cashback at restaurants/gas, auto-graduation at 7 months. Match-your-cashback first year.

capital-one-platinum-secured.review: Deposit as low as $49 for $200 line — the cheapest entry. 6-month auto-graduation review.

citi-secured-mastercard.review: $0 fee, $200-$2500 deposit range. Reports to all 3 bureaus. Best for rebuilding after bankruptcy.

opensky-secured-visa.review: No credit check required (rare!). $35/yr fee. Best for those who can't pass any hard pull.

chime-credit-builder-card.review: $0 fee, no minimum, no interest, no credit check. Spending paid from Chime account weekly.
